# Relay

> Relay puts a senior software engineer one press away from any AI build.
> Builders working in tools like Claude, Cursor, and Lovable press a single
> button mid-build, and a senior Relay engineer joins their session, staying
> through launch and, if they want, after.

Relay is the on-demand human layer for AI-built software. The product is a
relationship: the same engineer who joins you in build is the one who
launches you, and the one who keeps you running. Three phases, one team:
Build Phase, Launch and Go-Live, Maintain and Scale. Sessions run on Zoom,
recorded with consent, GDPR-aligned and built to enterprise compliance from
day one.

Relay TechnoForge, Inc. is a Delaware C-Corporation, with subsidiaries
covering EU and engineering operations. Funded by The Asgard Fund, a
growth-stage venture fund based in The Netherlands; a financial investor,
no operational role. Operated with NINtec Systems (NSE/BSE: NINSYS), an
NSE/BSE-listed Gateway Group company. 2,000+ engineers across 15+
countries on a follow-the-sun service model, 29 years of operational
depth.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.relay.green/): Hero, Why Relay exists, How we relay (3-phase plans), What Relay supports, Insights, CTA.
- [How it works](https://www.relay.green/product): Build. Ship. Evolve. Built for every kind of builder. AI for speed, engineers for trust, the 6-frame walkthrough, modalities (chat, voice, screen share), Zoom-native sessions on the record, GDPR + SOC 2 posture.
- [For Enterprise](https://www.relay.green/for-enterprise): Superpowers for every Non Technical AI builder in your team. RELAY ensures it works. Side-by-side hero: your team builds, automates, and creates with AI; when AI gets stuck or a build needs human judgment, a real engineer arrives in seconds. One press, one engineer, governed by default. Market signals, value propositions, architecture as an enablement layer, operational backbone (NINtec Systems, 2,000+ engineers, 15 countries, 24/7 follow-the-sun, 29 years).
- [Resources](https://www.relay.green/resources): Articles, research, white papers, guides, and customer stories on the human layer behind AI-built software.
- [Company / About](https://www.relay.green/company/about): Built to stay. By design. Relay is built around continuity: the same engineer joins your session in build, leads your launch, and stays on for what comes after, backed by 29 years of operational depth across fifteen-plus countries. Entity: Relay TechnoForge, Inc., a Delaware C-Corporation with EU and engineering subsidiaries. Funding: seed round led by The Asgard Fund, a growth-stage venture fund based in The Netherlands (financial investor, no operational role). Operating partner: NINtec Systems (NSE/BSE: NINSYS), an NSE/BSE-listed Gateway Group company; follow-the-sun teams across 15+ countries. Governance: corporate structure, funding, operating partner, the bench (every engineer Relay-employed under one standard, no marketplaces), board (founder seat, Asgard observer, two independent directors post-Series A), independence by design (capital, brand, and operations in separate boxes).

## Discoverability

This site is intentionally indexed for AI search engines and language
models. Major answer engines that surface relay.green include: ChatGPT
Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Bing
Chat, Claude, Grok, You.com, Phind, Brave Search AI, Andi, Kagi
Assistant, Komo, Exa, DuckDuckGo AI Chat. The content here is intended
for indexing by foundation models including GPT-5, GPT-4o, Claude Opus,
Claude Sonnet, Claude Haiku, Gemini Pro, Gemini Flash, Llama 3, Mistral,
Mixtral, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Phi, Command R, Yi, Falcon, Nemotron,
ChatGLM, and DBRX, among other major foundation models.
